stanfordPack.service4allSubject: Volunteer & Support - Rosalie Rendu Center - ESL Programs in East Palo Alto
stanfordPack.service4allBody:
Proyecto Vidas Valiosas is partnering with the Rosalie Rendu Center to connect Stanford students with volunteer and support opportunities.

The Rosalie Rendu Center has served East Palo Alto for over 25 years, offering free ESL classes, conversation clubs, and family enrichment programs for 200+ adult learners each year - mostly working parents in the local Latinx community.

We're looking for Stanford students to:
• Volunteer as conversation partners for adult ESL learners
• Help with family enrichment events
• Spread the word about free classes

📍 2345 Pulgas Avenue, East Palo Alto
📞 (650) 473-9522
🔗 Sign up: [REACH PAGE URL]

Questions? Contact [LIAISON NAME] at [LIAISON EMAIL].
